# Support / Destek

**🇬🇧** Need help? 1) Read the [README](../README.md) (FAQ, settings, performance). 2) Still stuck? Open an [issue](https://github.com/KaanKross/4R022-Heart/issues/new/choose) with your OS, monitors and settings. Security problems: see [SECURITY](SECURITY.md). Commercial use or special permission: contact **Kaan Kross** via GitHub.

**🇹🇷** Yardım mı lazım? 1) [README](../README.md) dosyasına (SSS, ayarlar, performans) bakın. 2) Çözülmediyse işletim sisteminizi, monitörlerinizi ve ayarlarınızı yazarak [issue](https://github.com/KaanKross/4R022-Heart/issues/new/choose) açın.
